messages:
ria: heads up - planning SDK 3.2 unpin in eu-west tonight 23:00 PT. found a quant/kernel mismatch affecting qv2-legacy; we need a sticky runtime pin for that model-group until patch lands.
omar: ok. suggest staggered unpin: non-qv2 traffic first, hold qv2 group. set deploy-bot slices 10/40/100.
tess: agree. add holdlist for qv2-legacy and route them to runtime v2.14.1. also require a small eval run every 5m during rollout.
infra-bot: command: `opsctl holdlist add qv2-legacy --reason "quant-kernel-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z`
ria: runtime pin: runtime:2.14.1+kvcache for scope=model-group:qv2-legacy. omar, can infra reserve 2 canaries in eu-west?
omar: reserving 2 canaries eu-west-1 + 1 eu-central. healthcheck target: 200rps.
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin eu-west @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. slices: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m.
tess: rollback triggers: increase 5xx >0.5% over baseline, p95 latency +30% for qv2 after routing, TER/oom spike, or eval drift >4%.
omar: set alerts and 20m cooldown between slices. escape-hatch: `deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-eu-unpin --reason telemetry`
ria: i'll draft internal release note: note known issue for qv2 routing and expected p95 bump ~10-15% for pinned group.
deploy-bot: started: slice 10%. canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. monitoring links posted.
omar: pod-2 healthy -> moving to 40% per plan.
tess: if we must rollback, notify support/CS and update external docs. ria will handle comms.
infra-bot: runtime pin created id=pin-9001 expires=2026-03-25T04:00:00Z
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin eu-west reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:05:12Z. no rollback triggered.
ria: follow-up: schedule compatibility smoke for other model groups in 48h and track post-unpin telemetry for 72h.
